validity.recommendation: Swap the Status/Length/Location [ref] cells off the generic egyptoil-gas.com search-results URL onto the specific Egypt Oil & Gas Dec-2023 report (Talkha-Tanta-Cairo, https://egyptoil-gas.com/reports/egypts-natural-gas-pipelines-towards-a-regional-transit-hub/), which is the actual evidence and matches on name, endpoints, length AND capacity.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + SPEC: found strong independent corroboration this is a real, correctly-specified trunk line. Egypt Oil & Gas magazine's Dec-2023 report 'Egypt's Natural Gas Pipelines: Towards a Regional Transit Hub' (byline Jolly Monsef/Mariam Ahmed/Abdullah Mostafa, citing Wood Mackenzie data, PDF metadata CreateDate 2023-12-10) carries a 'Nile Delta/Cairo/Nile Valley' table listing 'Talkha-Tanta-Cairo | Talkha Distribution Station | Cairo | 125 [km] | 800 [mmcf/d]' -- an EXACT match to GEM's LengthKnown=125.00 km and Capacity=800.00 MMcf/d, and it confirms the StartLocation=Talkha/EndCountryOrArea endpoint pairing (Talkha Distribution Station -> Cairo). The same table's adjacent rows (Damanhur-Tanta 60km/700.1mmcf/d) match P8019 in this scope exactly, and Abu Madi-Talkha I/II (35km each, feeding INTO the Talkha Distribution Station) are the upstream segments that this pipeline continues FROM -- consistent, sequential infrastructure, not a duplicate of anything in the 40-row roster. CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType=transmission is correct -- this is a Delta-to-Cairo trunk carrying gas onward from a distribution station, not a gathering/feeder line. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 40-row roster; no other row plausibly describes this same physical corridor (Damanhur-Tanta P8019 is a different route converging separately on Tanta from the west; Kuraimat-Al Tebbin P8021 and Zaafarana-Kuraimat P8014 are a separate Suez-side corridor). ATTRIBUTION: Fuel=Gas and StartState/Province=Dakahlia (Talkha) / EndState/Province=Cairo are consistent with the source. CAVEAT (why not a clean pass): the sheet's OWN existing refs are weak -- I ran url_verifier per the SOP and confirmed the orchestrator's own findings: the Status/Length/Location [ref] cells all point to a bare egyptoil-gas.com SEARCH-RESULTS URL (https://egyptoil-gas.com/?s=Gas+Pipelines+Egypt) that does not itself name this pipeline or its values (I re-ran the search live: none of the 10 returned articles mention Talkha, Tanta, or this pipeline). That generic URL should never have been treated as sufficient support; I found the actual supporting article and it independently corroborates the row -- but this counts as ONE strong independent source, not two, so I am NOT raising this to 'high'. Diameter=28in is sourced separately to the EGAS Annual Report 2018 PDF (page 35 GASCO national-grid map, the cohort's standard visual-identification source per the country note); that report's table does not carry a diameter column so it can't cross-check the Wood Mackenzie figures, and I could not visually locate a 'Talkha' label on my own read of the p.35 map crop (Tanta, Mansoura/'South Mansora', Shabsheer/Transgas, Banha and Qusina are all legible nearby, but no explicit Talkha node) -- consistent with the country note's warning that this is a map-reading source and absence of a label is not itself disproof, but I flag it honestly as unconfirmed by me rather than claim I saw it. NOTE FOR THE BATCH: this Dec-2023 Egypt Oil & Gas report table is very likely the underlying source (via Wood Mackenzie) for much of this 40-row 'NA' cohort -- its neighboring table rows line up closely with several other in-scope PIDs (e.g. P8019 Damanhur-Tanta matches exactly; P8084 Suez-Cairo Ring is close, 90.5 vs GEM's 90.00; a couple of others show real length disagreements, e.g. its 'Ras Shukheir-Suez Gas Trunkline'=245km vs P8016's 256km, and 'Korimat-Al Tebbin'=60km vs P8021's 87km) -- worth the orchestrator pulling the full table for cross-checking other shards, though I did not chase those since they belong to other PIDs.

summary: P8024 Talkha-Tanta-Cairo: confirmed (caveat) -- real, correctly classified, no duplicate; independently corroborated (Egypt Oil & Gas Dec-2023 report / Wood Mackenzie) with EXACT length (125km) and capacity (800 MMcf/d) match; recommend swapping the sheet's generic search-URL refs for the specific article. No UNRESOLVED items; diameter (28in, EGAS Annual Report 2018) stands on its existing single source, unconfirmed by me on a second source.
